# Array-bound element selection with a unary consumer

The sole Object-bounded method formal occurs in one array, one complete unary
selector and the direct result. The original static overload forwards an exact
boolean snapshot to the selecting body. Public source and SDK providers share
the same contract. The owned private variant uses a package owner, private
static methods and its private static member interface.

Frozen definitions and observers check array and element identity, rank/flag
callback order, live fields, mutations, captured boolean and result values,
late result casts, ignored calls and exact checked/Error identity. Independent
wrong programs must fail the oracle. Generic signatures, compiler metadata,
method descriptors and original class identities remain unchanged.
